definitions.explanation: The share of a population that is in work. In Japanese statistics it is the number of employed people divided by the population aged fifteen and over, and it is often given for a group such as women or older people.

examples.japanese: {就業率|しゅうぎょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{就業率|しゅうぎょうりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The employment rate of women is rising year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{就業率|しゅうぎょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Behind the rise in the employment rate of older people lie the labor shortage and the pension problem.

notes:
Made of ⟦{就業|しゅうぎょう}→就業：32453_shuugyou⟧ (being in work) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate). A news and statistics word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {就業率|しゅうぎょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}する→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧: the employment rate rises
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{就業率|しゅうぎょうりつ}: women's employment rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{失業率|しつぎょうりつ}→失業率：32266_shitsugyouritsu⟧: unemployment rate — the share of the labor force that wants work but has none, a different base from {就業率|しゅうぎょうりつ}
- {就職率|しゅうしょくりつ}: job-placement rate — the share of graduates who found jobs
